balance.go:*btree.balanceNonroot.note: faithful port of balance_nonroot (btree.c:8248-9030), specialised to any-store's index btree; enumerated deviations in the balance.go header. Live path for both insert splits and delete-side merges

balance.go:*btree.freePageDeferred.note: frees surplus old siblings after a balance (btree.c:9000-9004); thin wrapper over pager.freePage

balance.go:*btree.rewriteParentAfterBala.note: editPage replacement (deviation 2): wholesale parent rebuild subsuming put4byte (btree.c:8759) and per-divider insertCell (btree.c:8888)

btree.go:*Cursor.CountUntil.note: any-store range-count fast path batching by page

btree.go:*Cursor.Skip.note: any-store batched forward skip; no SQLite counterpart

btree.go:*Cursor.SkipBackward.note: any-store batched backward skip; no SQLite counterpart

btree.go:*btree.Delete.note: now drives delete-time rebalancing: an underfull (>2/3 free) non-empty leaf funnels through balanceNonroot (deleteRebalanceLeaf), matching the balance() call in sqlite3BtreeDelete (btree.c:10005-10010); also ports the cell-drop (dropCell/allocateSpace). Phase 1 — see any-store-tests:docs/any-store/btree/plans/2026-05-23-delete-time-rebalancing.md

btree.go:*btree.collapseSingleChild.note: balance-shallower: copies a single surviving child's content into the parent and frees it (copyNodeContent + freePage, btree.c:8977-8985); page-1 DB-header handling like finishParentRemoval

btree.go:*btree.collectInteriorCells.note: any-store helper used by rebuild/balance paths

btree.go:*btree.collectLeafCells.note: any-store helper used by rebuild/balance paths

btree.go:*btree.completeMergeUpward.note: delete-side: cascades parent under-fullness up the path and collapses a single-child root (balance-shallower, btree.c:8960-8985); any-store's analogue of balance()'s do-loop unwinding

btree.go:*btree.deleteRebalanceInterior.note: interior analogue of deleteRebalanceLeaf: drives an underfull interior page through balanceNonroot with inject.active=false

btree.go:*btree.deleteRebalanceLeaf.note: drives an underfull (>2/3 free) non-empty leaf through balanceNonroot with inject.active=false (k=nOld-1 merge), matching SQLite delete-merge via balance()->balance_nonroot (btree.c:10010)

btree.go:*btree.finishParentRemoval.note: shared delete-path tail (empty-leaf path): writes post-removal parent cells; 0-cell root collapse via copyNodeContent (btree.c:8148); non-root 0-cell interior left as a degenerate rightChild-only page for a later balance (root-gated per btree.c:8960)

btree.go:*btree.interiorUnderfull.note: the nFree*3 > usable*2 rebalance gate, negated from btree.c:10005; decides the underfull-parent cascade after a delete-side merge

btree.go:*btree.removeMergedRightSeparat.note: mergeRight separator removal: repoints the freed page's right-neighbor slot to the kept page, then drops the divider cell. Reachable only via the dead tryMergeLeaf

btree.go:*btree.splitLeafRightmostAppend.note: fast-path for rightmost-append splits — allocates one new sibling, leaves caller's full leaf untouched, hands the new cell to the new page

btree.go:*btree.splitRootLeafAndInsert.note: root-leaf overflow: balance_deeper (btree.c:9052-9097) then a 2-way split of the new child; retains the former splitLeafAndInsertWithPath body for the root case

btree.go:*btree.tryMergeLeaf.note: DEAD CODE: a non-faithful 2-page-only merge with no production caller (Delete rebalances via balanceNonroot/deleteRebalanceLeaf). Test-exercised only, pending retirement per the delete-rebalance plan; balance_nonroot cited as conceptual analogue only

btree.go:leafKeyAt.note: any-store light key peek; no overflow

debug_trace_on.go:trace.note: Thin wrapper over log.Logger.Printf for build-tagged tracing; any-store-specific debug scaffolding with no SQLite origin.

namespace_size.go:leafCellPayloadLen.note: decodes full key/value payload lengths from a leaf cell for size accounting; the length-only slice of btreeParseCellPtr — any-store-specific helper

pager.go:*pager.commit.note: schema-cookie bump at pager.go:1864 (FileChangeCount at 1861) is the sqlite3BtreeUpdateMeta equivalent

pager.go:*pager.committedCounters.note: reads FileChangeCount/SchemaCookie from the writer-owned in-memory page-1 header, mirroring SQLite reading meta from the cached page-1 PgHdr rather than re-reading the WAL

pager.go:*pager.detachBackup.note: inverse of attachBackupObject; called by Backup.Finish (backup.c:589–597)

pager.go:*pager.dispatchBackupRestart.note: fans out a restart signal to all attached Backups when WAL reset or page-cache invalidation makes already-copied tracking meaningless

pager.go:*pager.dispatchBackupUpdate.note: fans out the per-page update hook to all attached Backups after each committed write so already-copied pages stay current

pager.go:*pager.initNewDB.note: any-store initializes empty page 1 at pager open; SQLite defers to btree layer

pager.go:*pager.readHeaderCounters.note: any-store cross-process header read bypassing cache/index

pager.go:*pager.truncateTo.note: backup destination shrink path (backup.c:530); discards writerCache pages beyond the new size

pcache.go:*pcache.create.note: initial 'already cached?' probe via hashFind (pcache1FetchNoMutex); on allocate, hashInsert links into apHash (was pc.pages[pgno]=p). nPage replaces len(pages).

pcache.go:*pcache.discard.note: lookup via hashFind; hashRemove (pcache1RemoveFromHash) clears page.inCache so a still-pinned discarded page is not re-LRU'd on release

pcache.go:*pcache.evictOne.note: pops LRU tail then hashRemove (was delete(pc.pages, p.pgno))

pcache.go:*pcache.fetch.note: lookup via hashFind (chained-bucket probe, pcache1FetchNoMutex step 1) then pin + lruRemove on a clean hit (pcache1PinPage)

pcache.go:*pcache.hashFind.note: chained-bucket probe apHash[pgno&(nHash-1)] walked by hashNext, the read-only half of pcache1FetchNoMutex step 1 (pcache1.c:1009-1010); shared by fetch/create. Closes NOTES §9 drift #2.

pcache.go:*pcache.hashInsert.note: links page at bucket head, sets page.inCache, bumps nPage, resizes at load factor 1.0 (pcache1.c:894 nPage>=nHash → pcache1ResizeHash)

pcache.go:*pcache.hashRemove.note: unlinks page from its bucket chain and clears page.inCache (pcache1.c:601-613); the inCache flag is a v2 addition for pages removed while pinned (no SQLite equivalent — SQLite forbids that)

pcache.go:*pcache.release.note: gates LRU insert on page.inCache (field read) instead of the former second map lookup (pc.pages[p.pgno]==p); overfull path calls hashRemove (pcache1RemoveFromHash). SQLite's pcache1Unpin adds to LRU unconditionally (its invariants forbid removing a pinned page); the inCache gate is the v2 ghost-page guard.

pcache.go:*pcache.resizeHash.note: doubles apHash and rehashes at load factor 1.0; power-of-two sizing (floor 256) so pgno&(nHash-1) is a mask (pcache1.c:535-567)

pcache.go:hashSizeFor.note: smallest power-of-two >= n and >= 256, matching pcache1ResizeHash's floor (pcache1.c:543)

pcache.go:newPcache.note: seeds apHash to a power-of-two size (>= maxPages, floor 256), mirroring pcache1Create which calls pcache1ResizeHash at creation (pcache1.c:789) to seed nHash=256

shm.go:newHeapShm.note: heap-backed shm constructor for single-process mode

shm_other.go:newPlatformShm.note: heap-backed shm fallback for platforms without mmap support

wal.go:*walIndex.getLatest.note: cache-invalidation lookup; no direct SQLite counterpart
